descriptions.1: Duy Nhân pandan tea with a gentle aroma and light natural sweetness. Brew hot or iced — a refreshing Da Nang gift in every cup.
descriptions.2: Duy Nhân beef jerky with a tender chew and well-balanced seasoning. Savory, lightly spicy, and perfect for snacking or gifting.
descriptions.3: Sun-dried squid, shredded and ready to enjoy — naturally sweet with a satisfying chew. Great straight from the pack, lightly grilled, or with a cold drink.
descriptions.4: Premium dried golden threadfin bream with firm flesh and deep coastal sweetness. Delicious chili-salt fried or served as a savory snack.
descriptions.5: Soft, fragrant mung bean cakes with a classic nutty sweetness. A box of 6 — gentle, not overly sweet, and ideal as a Da Nang souvenir.
descriptions.6: Seasoned dried anchovy with a fragrant, savory-sweet balance. Crispy when pan-fried — a coastal snack the whole family loves.
